item.title: The Drive Team Podcast Trailer by The Drive Team: A VEX Robotics Podcast
item.description: Interested in the VEX Robotics Competition? Want to hear from fellow competitors and mentors? Excited about this season's game? Join Winston and Ev every two weeks as they interview members of the VRC community, analyze competitions, and discuss game strategies. Each episode will host a special guest to talk about their journey in robotics, as well as some tips and tricks in the world of VEX Robotics.

item.title: Episode 1 - Kevin Boenisch of RoboSource by The Drive Team: A VEX Robotics Podcast
item.description: Join Winston & Ev on the first episode of The Drive Team! In this episode, hear from Kevin Boenisch, the founder and president of RoboSource.net, and a former VEX Robotics Competition competitor. Kevin speaks about his experiences in VRC as well as his journey into starting the RoboSource company.
